text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—What kind of drama awaits in this year's 
"Oaks"?! The stands are filled with the 
feverish excitement of the fans!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dober's Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, I-I'm getting nervous~~! Mejiro 
Dober, you can do this...!!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
Please... please let Dober-chan run with 
everything she's got...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I told you, you don't need to worry so 
much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...To be honest, yeah. But—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
See, if you think of it as trembling with 
excitement before battle, it's pretty 
reassuring, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let's just say I'm trembling with 
excitement. That sounds a lot more 
reassuring, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Do you believe in me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, do you believe in me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Do you still... believe in my running, in 
my strength?"
choice_data_list:
You are the strongest Uma Musume in the 
world.

You are the strongest Uma Musume in the 
world, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Do you still... believe in my running, in

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what, you idiot! Why do you always have 
to say things like that?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. You really do always exaggerate 
things, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Today... I'll gladly accept those 
exaggerated words.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Those words are such a huge comfort to me 
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I'm off.
